findings.evidence: `MixedIIDWith.blockLaw_eq_pi_of_const` gives each singleton block map a probability measure, hence it is nonzero; Mathlib provides `AEMeasurable.of_map_ne_zero` at `Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure/Typeclasses/Probability.lean:131`, while `Measure.map` is zero when its function is not AEMeasurable (`Measure/Map.lean:92`).
findings.fix: Derive coordinate AEMeasurability from the singleton block-law equality and remove `hX` from all six signatures; use the derived fact internally for finite blocks and map composition.
findings.issue: The explicit `hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ` is redundant in `map_eq_of_const`, `iIndepFun_of_const`, both constant-characterization iff lemmas, and `conditionallyIIDWith_const_of_mixedIIDWith` (lines 94, 112, 143, 156, 176, 182), making the whole public API needlessly weaker.

summary: The constant-witness API unnecessarily requires coordinate AEMeasurability that already follows from the witness itself.
